offering_description.value: Mines and processes clay-based sorbent minerals and sells them mainly as cat litter, animal bedding, agricultural carriers, industrial absorbents and fluids purification media. Sells to retailers, wholesalers, animal owners, farms and industrial and food processors.

primary_products.value: cat litter; animal bedding; agricultural carriers; industrial absorbents; fluids purification clays

customer_segment.value: B2C: pet owners buying cat litter through retail stores and online; B2B: retailers and wholesalers, farms, feed producers, industrial plants, edible oil and renewable fuel processors

end_markets.value: pet care; agriculture; industrial manufacturing; food and edible oil processing; renewable fuels

revenue_model.value: product sales: mineral-based litter, absorbents, agricultural carriers and purification clays sold to customers

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: mines and processes clay minerals from its own deposits, sold to its own manufacturing and to other processors; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures sorbent products at its plants, sold to retailers, distributors and industrial customers; brand owner: sells its own consumer brands and private-label cat litter to retailers
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; brand owner

geography_served.value: North America: US national market with sales in Canada and some international markets including Europe and Asia

specialization.value: related lines: cat litter, animal bedding, agricultural carriers, industrial absorbents and fluids purification clays

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: grocery, mass merchant and pet retail chains selling cat litter; distributors / dealers: distributors serving agricultural, industrial and food processing customers; direct sales: direct sales to large industrial and food processing accounts; online: online retailers selling cat litter to consumers
distribution_channels.category: third-party retail; distributors / dealers; direct sales; online

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: mining and plant safety, environmental and food-contact rules from regulators such as MSHA and EPA
